rationale: Build on the reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a compact structural change: store forward tail states and let each recurrent tail block blend its own local forward anchor with the final decoder anchor through a learned scalar. This targets the still-promising reverse-tail anchor family, keeps shapes compile-stable, adds few bytes, and directly changes the carry path that matters for final int8 roundtrip behavior.
title: Blended Local-Global Tail Anchors
